summary: Smoke-tested D-ENERGY backend (JWT auth, generic CRUD, dashboard stats, settings, object storage upload/download) and frontend (login, dashboard load, Prosumator vs DI-U checklists, client CRUD + search, Simulare calculation). All critical flows pass. 12 Romanian modules reachable; prosumator (12-item checklist) and diu (10-item checklist) are correctly separated.
passed: GET /api/auth/me returns admin user with Bearer token
GET /api/stats/dashboard returns {clients, diu, mono, pending, recent}
GET /api/settings returns company data (D-ENERGY / DNS HOSTESS S.R.L.)
POST/GET /api/data/clients CRUD works; owner field populated
POST /api/upload stores file (storage_path returned); GET /api/files/{path}?auth=<token> returns the file bytes correctly
UI login via data-testid login-email/password/submit navigates to dashboard
Prosumator form shows 12 checklist items (data-testid check-*)
DI-U form shows 10 checklist items (correctly separated from prosumator)
Client CRUD via UI: add-btn opens form, save-btn persists, items-table shows row; search-input filters correctly (3 -> 1 row for 'UI Client X')
Prosumator UI save with required client_name ref persists record (rows went 1 -> 2)
Simulare page: sim-calc present; filling area=500 yields visible kWp (86.4) and annual production (86,400 kWh)
notes: Did not exhaustively test every module (mono, panels, anti, pram, equipment, power). Catalog/Distributors render not deeply verified beyond page load. Documents UI upload (doc-client select + doc-file + upload-btn) not driven through UI but underlying /api/upload + /api/files was verified end-to-end via API. Owner-based data isolation code path exists on backend (owner set on create) but was not verified by logging in as a second user.
